title: 14th Meeting of the Strategic Priorities and Policy Committee

content.string: The meeting is called to order at 4:00 PM; it being noted that the following members were in remote attendance, Councillors M. van Holst, M. Salih, J. Helmer, M. Hamou, A. Hopkins, P. van Meerbergen, S. Turner, S. Hillier.
